text: hm. M already is for create face between two edges. so i assume that wont be a problem? or what
resolution: Answered the M-key conflict concern from req_3382's weld: there is no conflict — Create Face (bridge two edges / fill a loop) is and always was bound to C, untouched. M previously ran Merge Faces in every mesh mode; in vertex/edge mode that only produced a 'select faces' error, so Weld took over an empty slot via mode-scoped keymap rows, and face mode's M (Merge Faces / part merge on 2+ outliner rows) is byte-for-byte unchanged. Flagged the one real adjacency: in edge mode with two edges selected both verbs apply — C bridges, M collapses — and both appear labeled in the contextual toolbar, with single-step undo covering a mispress. No code changed.
